record_title: Exact complete-Bernstein thresholds for the largest ultraspherical zero in degrees four and five
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Exact only for the largest zero in degrees 4 and 5; the all-degree optimal threshold remains open. Failure beyond d=3 or d=4 is failure of the complete-Bernstein/Pick property and does not by itself settle the weaker Bernstein property. Full-text comparison was made with arXiv:2609.19186v1; a metadata index reports a 2026-09-18 update whose full text was not available for inspection, creating a specific residual originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
